project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components
language: JavaScript (ES modules in renderer, CommonJS in main)
build_system: Electron Forge (forge.config.js), no npm available in sandbox
build_command: Not runnable - npm not available in sandbox
verification_instructions: Verify via AST parsing (node -e require/import checks) since npm/electron unavailable
setup_instructions: npm install && npm start (not available in sandbox)
environment_constraints: No npm packages available. Cannot run electron. Validate via static analysis and node require() checks for CommonJS files.
contribution_requirements: Run prettier before committing. Use Lit (not React) for components. Maintain existing patterns.
key_patterns: Main process: CommonJS (require/module.exports). Renderer: ES modules (import from lit-core-2.7.4.min.js bundled in assets). Stores in src/stores/ extend Store base class. Services in src/services/. Shared UI components in src/components/ui/ as custom elements (cd-toggle, cd-slider, cd-select, cd-keybind-input, cd-setting-row). IPC bridge: renderer calls ipcRenderer.invoke, main process registers ipcMain.handle. Global event bus: window.cheatingDaddy.events (EventTarget). Toast notifications via showToast().
directory_structure: src/ - main source. src/components/app/ - main app shell. src/components/views/ - page views. src/components/ui/ - shared reusable components. src/stores/ - reactive state stores. src/services/ - service layer. src/utils/ - utilities (window.js, renderer.js, gemini.js, etc). src/typing/ - typing system. src/assets/ - bundled libs (lit-core).
